Maharashtra Deputy CM Eknath Shinde Hospitalized Briefly

Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde was admitted to a private hospital in Thane after his health suddenly deteriorated. Doctors stated his condition is currently stable and he is receiving treatment. Party leaders visited him following his admission.
